Hello! This is an announcement from Soulworker.

We have identified an issue affecting character creation on certain servers. Currently, when attempting to use a character name that is already taken, no error message or prompt will appear.

Normally, you would receive a message indicating the name is unavailable, but due to this issue, no such notification is displayed.

- CN servers are not affected

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

notes.title: [Notice] Transaction Restriction System Changes (08/07/25)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d0f343240d222afcf346c478d79025ad8d836f7d.jpg"][/img]

Hello! This is an announcement from Soulworker.

We would like to inform you of the changes made to the following item-related restrictions for accounts, which were applied in March and May 2025.

[b]Affected Features:[/b]
- Trade (1:1 Transaction)
- Mail (H.E.M.S)
- Market
- League Storage

[b]### Restriction Changes[/b]

[b]- Before Update:[/b]
※ You can view the previously implemented transaction restrictions in the announcement below:

[Notice] Transaction Restriction System Changes (05/15/25)
[url=https://vfun-lounge.valofe.com/page/soulworker/Notice/25733][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e72f5c83e0e7a918a48e45f4715ceaa05a522974.jpg"][/img][/url]

[b]- After the Update:[/b]
※ The following features require the character to be Level 85:
  - 1:1 Trading
  - Mail (H.E.M.S)
  - Market

※ The features listed below will be restricted for 30 days after an account's first Cash Shop purchase:
  - This applies to:
    - Accounts created after the August 7 update
    - Accounts created before August 7 that have never made a Cash Shop purchase

    [b]Restricted features:[/b]
    - 1:1 Trading
    - Mail (H.E.M.S)
    - Market
    - League Storage

[b]Note:[/b]
- If your 30-day restriction is still active, you may not be able to wrap costumes.
- The 30-day countdown will now be displayed on your Profile menu.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5c894763ebadcf89e036252078fbd7747537a060.png"][/img]

[b]### Amendments FAQ[/b]

[b]#1[/b]

[b]Question:[/b]
- I made my first Cash Shop purchase on July 21. Will the 60-day restriction still apply after the August 7 update?

[b]Answer:[/b]
- No. Starting August 7, the 60-day restriction will be shortened by 30 days.

[b]Example:[/b]
- Before August 7 Policy:
  - Account Created: April 13
  - Purchase Date: July 21
  - Item Restriction: 60-day countdown begins
  - Transaction Restriction: 60-day countdown begins
  - Both restrictions end: September 21

[b]- After August 7 Policy:[/b]
  - A 30-day reduction will be applied to the transaction restriction.
  - New Transaction Restriction End Date: August 21

[b]#2[/b]

[b]Question:[/b]
- What happens to accounts that have already completed the Transaction Policy before the March 2025 update?

[b]Answer:[/b]
- If your account already fulfilled the initial transaction requirement (e.g., first Cash Shop purchase completed before March 2025), you will retain full access to the following features without further restrictions:
  - 1:1 Trading
  - Mail (H.E.M.S)
  - Market
  - League Storage

[b]Example:[/b]
- An old account that met the first-purchase condition
- Made a Cash Shop purchase by July 10
- After the August 7 update, no transaction restrictions will be displayed on the account[/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/757a1b6a05608f23b618095734082db46191f0e0.png[/img]

Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.

We would like to inform you about the current development status of SoulWorker.

The transition progress is running smoothly and we plan to complete it by February. Further updates will be released sequentially from March onwards. 

We are also excited to announce some of the content which is currently in progress.

[b]Future Updates:[/b]

[b]Content:[/b]
- Addition of Hidden Hideout: Heroic Mode, entry-level 82 / number of participants: 1~4 players. 
Once the raid is opened, this content can be participated in indefinitely.
- Golden Maze (Tentative name): Additional content necessary for expanding functions of reinforcement will be scheduled. 
- A new maze will be added at Episode 2.5. With the addition of the new story, the level will be raised to 85 and the Mastery Level will be adjusted too.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/67b2734890713e40be4566b6f99873f93ed50489.png[/img]

[b]Future Sale Items:[/b]
- [Dhana] The Lord of Dark Forces 

[b]System changes related:[/b]
- DirectX 11 Support: We are going to apply updates for DirectX to provide better game optimization. With updates in DirectX 11, gameplay in an improved environment will be applied where several characters and NPCs appear simultaneously. 
※ Depending on the condition of gameplay, there are cases where it may not be possible to experience the effects.
- Skill adjustment: Skill balance will be adjusted for all characters.
- Upgrade: The maximum enhancement value will be increased from +9 to +15.
- Scheduled addition of Mystic Akashic Records [Tenebris]

Regarding the update schedule, we are currently adjusting it, so we will inform everyone once the details are decided.

Furthermore, we will be re-running past in-game events to make it easier for players to strengthen their equipment that can be obtained from the current content until the next update.

Once again, we apologize for keeping everyone waiting. In the future, we will keep you informed of the development status and update the schedule to the extent that it can be disclosed.

Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] Trade Restriction System Change - Cash Shop Product
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/757a1b6a05608f23b618095734082db46191f0e0.png[/img]

Hello, this is SoulWorker Operation Team.
Changes in the Trading Restriction Mechanism for Cash Items purchased in the Cash Shop will be applied sequentially through the first (Dec 7th) and second (Dec 21st) updates in December, 2023.
The details are as follows:

[Current Restriction Mechanism]
※ Users with More than 51 Cumulative Attendance days (ACCOUNT BASIS): 
> Purchase Costumes and Costume PKG → [Can be Traded]

※ Users with Less than 51 Cumulative Attendance days (ACCOUNT BASIS): 
> Purchase Costumes and Costume PKG → [Cannot be Traded: For 30 Days]

[Amended Restriction Mechanism]
※ Trading [b](Market/Personal Transaction/H.E.M.S)[/b] is restricted for 30 days after the first purchase of Cash Items in the Cash Shop. (ACCOUNT BASIS)
> Accounts with a record of purchasing Cash Items in Cash Shop [after October 2nd, 2020] can use the trading system normally.
> For accounts with NO record of purchasing Cash Items in Cash Shop [after October 2nd, 2020], the trading system will be restricted for 30 days upon the first purchase of Cash Items in Cash Shop.

※ The minimum level required to use the Trading Function is raised to Level 82. (ACCOUNT BASIS) [b](Already Applied on December 7th Update)[/b]

※ The Trading Restriction Mechanism applied after February 23rd Update will be DELETED.
> [Trading allowed for more than 51 days of Cumulative Attendance and 30-day Trading Restriction for less than 51 days of Cumulative Attendance] will be DELETED.

[Application Date]
- After the December 21st Update

[b]* More details of the new Trading Restriction Mechanism will be announced through ‘[Notice] 231221 Update Note Preview’.[/b]

To create a fair gaming culture, SoulWorker keeps monitoring abnormal gameplay, including continuously abusing in-game systems and illegal programs. 
Please keep in mind that any actions found violating the operating policy and taking advantage of unfair means will lead to restriction of your gameplay.

We will always do our best to provide a smooth and comfortable gaming environment.

We hope that there will be no confusion due to the above changes. 

Thank you for your love and support for our game. SoulWorker will try to provide a better service for our users.

notes.title: [Notice] 230907 Update Note Preview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a117b6e9924568a62686ccb2cbfd1d9128bc352a.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Here is the Update and Event News for September 7, 2023.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]◆ UPDATE RECAP[/b]
- New Raid [Vile Predator]
- Raid Balance Patch for [Tragic Fairy]

[b]▶ NEW RAID UPDATE – VILE PREDATOR[/b]
- [Vile Predator] Raid will be updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/36ae2c3c055550f2bc4146cf458014ff3c04ac64.png[/img]

- Vile Predator related Quest will be added in Arcadia Realm.
> Quest: The End of Evolution
> Clear ‘Encounter with Evolution’ Quest → Enable to receive [The End of Evolution] Quest

[b][ HOW TO ENTER ][/b]
* Must Complete ‘Encounter with Evolution’ Quest
→ Enable to enter [Operation Stratos] District by clicking the Icon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d67df0f8d10f430df878f5f17750dcadf01acb99.png[/img]
(Operation Stratos Icon)




[b][ RAID INFO ][/b]

< Hall of Flames >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5ae24cdbdb42c4a173b33fcf67c09d61677f75cd.jpg[/img]


< Scarlet Madness >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/141c2a77aec90896a2dc856ad0e8a0b3a243fb6d.jpg[/img]


< Howling Fang >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a9856d9bab9e851d47786ff2063480927cad5f58.jpg[/img]


< Evolving Habitation >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c43f895e36210d5053648c98d8dded9c5139c881.jpg[/img]

< Operation Stratos  (District)>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ce7bce03cc83d3e00ca557f5da33421b3e36f160.jpg[/img]


[b][HOW TO CREATE SQUAD][/b]
- Please go to the Raid District, "Operation Stratos" in order to play the "Vile Predator" Raid.
- "Operation Stratos" is used as a waiting area platform where users are able to control number of people, level of Raids, as well as leaving / re-entering the Maze.
- When creating a Squad, said Character will be set as the Squad Leader in which she/he can edit and start Raids.
- ‘Story Playback’ function cannot be activated in "Operation Stratos" district.



[b][RAID STRUCTURE][/b]
- Mazes in the Vile Predator
> (Sub Maze) Hall of Flames <Boss: Flemma>
> (Sub Maze) Scarlet Madness <Boss: Relfenne>
> (Sub Maze) Howling Fang <Boss: Gale>
> (Main Maze) Evolving Habitation <Boss: Vista>

- Normal (1 Player Only) / Hard (1~12 Players)
- Not Possible to Use [Active] Akashic Records

- HARD difficulty: 3 Parties
> Team [1]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [2]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [3]: Max 4 Team Members
> Sub Parties (Hall of Flames / Scarlet Madness / Howling Fang) → Defeat Flemma / Relfenne / Gale to gain Buffs for Entire Teams & gain Debuffs to weaken Vista
> Main Party (Evolving Habitation) → Try to Defeat Vista
- Each Maze of "Vile Predator" has a Re-Spawn limit of 3 times (Exception: Daily free Re-Spawn, Cash Re-Spawn).


[b][SQUAD FINDER][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f2601d373f0fe299d167ab693bd390ef73926f65.png[/img]

- Game Menu Icon [Squad Finder]: Enable to check Squad Lists
- Can [Apply] a Squad that you want to Join.
- Squad Leader: Can Accept or Decline a Squad Join Request from Squad Applicant.
- Squad can consist of at least 1 user and a maximum of 12.
- In order for smooth gameplay in Vile Predator, 12 users are Highly Recommended in a Squad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a6fd80c2aa5ade6fb6dd3fade1e5ce7f2806af9f.png[/img]

[b][SQUAD TEAM ORGANIZATION][/b]
- The Squad Leader is able to edit the Squad and put members into different Parties.
- The Squad is only editable BEFORE the start of the Raid.
- The First member of each TEAM within the Squad, the Team Leader, can start the Raid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/42136bbdfa31c227e7957f31622a095e5b70411c.png[/img]

                              < Before Team Organization > / <After Team Organization>


[b][RAID START][/b]
- Starting the Raid is possible through NPC [Rona] in [Operation Stratos].
- Starting a Raid is only possible when joined in a Squad.
- Starting the Raid is only possible by the Squad Leader.
- Another Raid cannot be started once one has been started.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6f83cab4cfee9e8dbd684276005f960d92180ff5.png[/img]



[b]▶ RAID PROGRESS BOARD[/b]

- When entering the Raid, clicking the icon next to Character Status UI at the top, the Raid Progress Board can be seen.
- Clicking the "Home" button on your keyboard will also allow you to see the Raid Progress Board after the Raid has started.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/dd5c2d20afc468ddc32c10311e06db090b1ac4e3.png[/img]


- A Maze activated in the Raid Progress Board UI can be entered by clicking it.
- Entering Mazes is only possible by Each Team Leader.
- All Raid progress can be tracked on the Raid Progress Board. After time has run out, the Raid is deemed a failure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/81430365fd79c6577b42c5274b58263368befbe2.png[/img]



[b]▶ MAZE PARTY (TEAM) OCCUPANCY[/b]

- Only one(1) party can enter one(1) Maze at a time and the current Party in each Maze is shown.
- Another Party cannot enter a Maze once another Party has entered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/714beeada403255379160370bd0845c3bc1f6a2c.png[/img]



[b]▶ MAIN MAZE[/b]

- Once the Main Maze is cleared, the Raid is deemed a Success.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b383f8ef0568c8db929bfcfa87c8a61248390f9a.png[/img]


[b]▶ NORMAL MAZE[/b]

- Normal Mazes are all Mazes that are not the Main Maze.
- After clearing a Normal Maze, it will allow another Maze to open and/or give Buffs to other Mazes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/49de83e98a568d7bc6dc622f06a764de64651bd5.png[/img]



[b]▶ LOCKED MAZE[/b]

- Locked Mazes cannot be entered at that moment.
- Once requirements for locked Mazes are met, they will be unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0bc5c5f9acf4b1cd46c588de787297fb36250769.png[/img]



[b]▶ COMBAT SUPPORT SKILLS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/80029b3a1bcab16c8e4164d3757c77f5a8e9e098.png[/img]

- Combat Support Skills are Available Only in Certain Mazes. (e.g. Vile Predator - Evolving Habitation)
- Combat Support Skills provide various help in clearing the maze.
- Combat Support Skills may be different for each maze.
- Combat Support Skill UI can be found At the Bottom of the Mini-Map when you enter the Combat Support Skill Available Maze.
- Evolving Habitation Maze (Combat Support Skill Lists): Can be checked at [Raid Progress Board].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5b78820b5fcbd409cb88804f5af2e041801e5533.png[/img]



[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL]  SKILL METER[/b]

- Combat Support Skill Meter will rise if a Special Action is performed, or if Time has passed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a5ac5061220ce34db659978892b838e088c7085f.png[/img]


- When the Skill Meter is MAX → Enable to use Combat Support Skill
- Combat Support Skill Meter will be Reset if you leave a Maze. 


[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL]  SKILL ACTIVATION[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ef4cd9655c1da8e4e996555884cd0ef0a3c262fb.png[/img]


- Combat Support Skill / Skill Meter are shared by party members and can be activated by any party member.
- There will be Max 3 Combat Support Skills in the Maze. Enable to select one of the skills to use when the skill meter (Max) is reached.
- Combat Support Skill is triggered in the Direction the Character is Looking at, and it doesn't interfere with the character's action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9b1c37bd81cc518b3a98d468abc31b41e1f0420c.png[/img]


- Skill Meter: 100% → Use Combat Support Skill → Skill Meter: 0%
- To Use the Combat Support Skill again → You need to make Skill Meter [ 100% ] again. 


[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL] ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/724c393912680b3a8aea12b50e412e9015da9d28.png[/img]

- Combat Support Skill (Default Settings): Keyboard [Ctrl] + 1 / 2 / 3
- Enable to change it under Key Settings (Hotkeys) in Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/aa96e022282b8dc0e1440de10474720201790de7.png[/img]

- Hover your Mouse Cursor over the Combat Support Skill icon → Enable to check a Description of the Skill


[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL] Evolving Habitation MAZE COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL LISTS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2df7a3fb9687a40e99bf14adfcb9e30468cfefd5.png[/img]

[b]▶ RAID REWARDS[/b]

- Once the Raid is finished successfully, all members of the Squad will get Rewards through H.E.M.S.
- If a user no longer has another chance to receive Rewards, Rewards will not be given.

[b]◆ 2023 July Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ July Second Update (on July 20th)[/b]

[b]1. EPISODE 2 (ACT 1 / ACT 2)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/303d055c6d31ab37fffec47bfff9d3213ddb2d96.png[/img]

★ Episode 2 is subtitled "Nowhere to Hide".

[i][b]Haven Island, a huge island in the East Cloudream.
It was once known as Paradise Island... But now there is no light and no human footprint at all. Heaven? That was a long time ago.
Yes... this is where the Second Story is about to begin; the island with mysterious sounds... and screams.[/b][/i]

That's where the SoulWorkers struggle to thwart Vista's demonic plan!


★ Episode 2 [Act 1 / Act 2] Update: July 20th, 2023
★ Episode 2 [Act 3] Update: August 3rd, 2023


[b]1-1. [NEW MAZE] MUTED HAVEN[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0b5b1bdd5256be34c737665a342df8c6b7f3a7aa.png[/img]

▶ Recommended: Lv. 79 or Higher

[i][b]Highly advanced science is nothing short of magic...
and the precarious earth will eventually die and disappear.
You mortal beings are useless, and time is worthless.
Every life and hope will turn to dust and ashes...
Now Perish.[/b][/i]


Heitz and Martin have finally found the location where Vista is believed to be located. No time to hesitate. They immediately called SoulWorkers.

Once known as Paradise Island, Haven Island was rich in trade with Arcadia Realm. But now there is no light and no human footprint. And Heitz told SoulWorkers it's time to begin a manhunt for Vista... right here.

SoulWorkers have finally arrived in Haven Island. A... paradise? The island is completely in ruins.
All of a sudden, the Vacuum Junk appears and attacks SoulWorkers. Something... Something's not right... They realize that bodies are Heavier than usual.

Heitz constantly coughs on her way to the lab. Eventually, she can't stand the pain and falls down.
SoulWorkers decide to leave Haven Island immediately and return to Arcadia Realm... to save her.
After arriving, they visit Sedurin to ask why Heitz is sick.

Sedurin has asked SoulWorkers to go back to Haven Island with her Signal Detector.
They hope this device finds out a certain signal that made Heitz sick and fall.


[b]1-2. [NEW MAZE] CHAMBER ASTRAY[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7602f27c5d6507fe58d8e24c36a8636e2eefda7c.png[/img]

▶ Recommended: Lv. 80 or Higher

[i][b]Ah yes. Science... It shall fulfill my dream, my ambition... my everything.
Yes, yes! Eat every single life and take all the souls in this pathetic world!
YOU... Make Me Complete![/b][/i]


Heitz was restored to health without any further problems. And SoulWorkers killed all the enemies at the laboratory entrance.
Now's the time for them to enter the lab of Vista. Heitz also called Thomas to the front of the laboratory, and she told him to go into the lab with the SoulWorkers...

No one had a map of the lab. But this place was too big and wide. SoulWorkers and Thomas were afraid they'd miss Vista here...
They were at a loss for how to find their destination. Just then, a mysterious girl appeared in front of them. The girl told them where to go to meet Vista.
And... she suddenly disappeared in a flash.


[b]1-3. [QUEST] STORY FOR EACH CHARACTER[/b]

1. Haru Estia

Thomas tried to go to Haven Island to disrupt Vista's experiment. But Haru killed Vista's test subjects a step ahead of Thomas to stop and calm him down.


2. Erwin Arclight

Erwin found Rona looked very tired than usual. He asked Rona if she was okay. Then, she told him that it was because the Coffee Truck failed to arrive due to the attack of Vacuum Junk. Rona also said that C-ration Coffee cannot be defined as coffee. Now, Erwin headed to Haven Island... to find authentic regular coffee.


3. Lily Bloommerchen

A boy didn't give up and kept trying to go to the island to find his parents. Lily promised the boy that she would find his parents instead. Then she headed to Haven Island.


4. Jin Seipatsu

Jin heard there was a unit out of touch on the way back from operations on Haven Island. So, he entered the island to search for them.


5. Stella Unibell

Stella heard a rumor from Rona that a ghost was coming out of Haven Island. She said she would deal with everything related to the ghost and headed for the island.


6. Iris Yuma

Iris heard that Michelle, her mother, suddenly became unconscious with the flu. Sedurin said it could be a Monopuhl Leave Addiction, not the flu. And Rona told Iris about the conspiracy of Congress about Monopuhl Leaves. But the problem was that the existing drugs administered to Michelle... did not work at all. Iris headed to Haven Island to find relevant data.


7. Chii Aruel

Chii tried to find the source of the dog odor coming from somewhere. However, the smell came from various objects. She guessed that this smell may have come from Haven Island.


8. Ephnel

A soldier told Ephnel about his friend who went missing during an operation. He asked her to search the island. Then Ephnel told the soldier she would do the job for 1,000,000 Zenny, and he accepted it.


9. Lee Nabi

Nabi heard rumors from Heitz and Rona that ghosts appear on Haven Island. So, Nabi set off to the island to confirm the truth.


10. Dhana Opini

Dhana wanted to go to Haven Island and find traces of Vista. Heitz accepted her request.



[b]2. MAX LEVEL CHANGE[/b]

- Current: Lv.79

- AFTER UPDATE: Lv.81

- Some [Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics] gaming environments may not be able to access the game.

- Some of Graphics Cards that [No Longer Support for DirectX 9] → It may not be able to access the game.

We are currently looking for ways to solve these issues.
Therefore, it is very difficult to respond immediately to inquiries related to these problems. (4/27 REVISED)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/76cc5489a1e535b9a01337da8966e5c0f33f9907.png[/img]

- Delete the Steam Client → Reinstall → Download all the redistributed files from Steam → This may resolve most of problems (Client Crashes / Infinite Loading / etc.)

* Must Install [ x64 Architecture ]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/55ee63a25754ab97c8cf32449b1c9b0f94cb060c.png[/img]

Dear SoulWorkers,

This is Kyeong-Bae, Park of Superany Studio in Lion Games.

It's already been a week.
How are you all?

First and foremost, thank you so much for sharing Your Suggestions and Opinions.
(Yes, I've read them ALL for sure.)

And, I have made my decision
after a number of passionate internal team debates.


[b]1. COSTUMES[/b]

There will be Two major changes.

(1) Purchase Costume → Possession (for a certain period) →[b] (After a certain period) Change to [Can be Traded][/b]

(2) Trade Costume → Possession (for a certain period) →[b] (After a certain period) Change to [Can be Traded][/b]

One of my studio members quoted Ernest Hemingway.
“The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.”

Of course, I trust YOU as you trust me.


[b]2. BROOCHES[/b]

I am so sorry that brooches (Cash Shop) will remain unchanged this time.
However, there will be a price adjustment (lowering of prices) for brooches.

Your Suggestion. Your Opinion. Yes, I do understand Your Frustration.

And this message can be another disappointment for you, 
but my team and I are trying to figure out the best way for all of us.

Lastly, I prepared a small gift for you.
Please please accept my humble gift through H.E.M.S.

[hr][/hr]
[Included Items]
▶TERA Brooch Select Option (Possession) x1
▶Unified TERA Brooch Cube (Possession) x5


[Gift Period]
▶ February 10th, 10 AM ~ February 26th, 1 AM [GMT]

[hr][/hr]
Thank You So Much for Your Patience.
Superany Studio and I will consider and develop contents you can love.

AGAIN and AGAIN, I am so delighted YOU are with us!

Sincerely,
Kyeong-Bae, Park

notes.title: [Producer’s Comment] About Costumes and Brooches
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/55ee63a25754ab97c8cf32449b1c9b0f94cb060c.png[/img]

Dear SoulWorkers,

This is Kyeong-Bae, Park of Superany Studio in Lion Games.

How are You? Yes, I heard and read every single voice of yours through our Operation Team.
So, I guess this is the right time to explain the reason for the Changes in Costume and Brooch.

[b]1. WHY I NEED TO CHANGE (Can be Traded → Possession)[/b]

First of all, Costumes / Brooches → [Possession] state
▶ I would like to inform you that this is just a [b]TEMPORARY[/b] measure!

Massive Chargeback of Cash Costumes and Brooches are the crucial reason of the change.
It negatively exceeded my studio's expectations.

However, Superany Studio and I hear and read all your voices through various communities.
While writing this to you, my studio is trying to find a solution.

[b]I PROMISE YOU![/b]
WHEN the prevention and solution are found, [Possession] will go back to [Can be Traded] again.

2. MISTAKE (Crafted Brooches → Possession)
There was a mistake in Crafted Brooches (Brooch Transmitter Select Option / NPC ‘EO’) were also changed to the [Possession] state.
But, it was not possible to fix through simple data modification as several other side effects were expected at the time.

As it was announced in [Notice] 230202 Update Note Preview, this issue will be properly fixed in February 16th Update.

▶ Crafted Brooches from Brooch Transmitter Select Option / NPC ‘EO’ → Can be Traded

I will let you know more detailed information about this modification through ‘[Notice] 230216 Update Note Preview’.

No doubt, it’s my mistake. I wanted to say I’m terribly sorry to you all.

Superany Studio and I, Kyeong-Bae, Park, will consider and develop contents you can love.
ALWAYS, Your Support means the world, and I can’t thank you enough.
AGAIN, I am so delighted YOU are with us!

Thank YOU so much.

[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.

[b][ More About Parallel Metronome ] [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/34505d7fd19394b38a5244f8279b1ba8e97b9b44.png[/img]

[b]1. HOW TO ENTER[/b]
- Must ACCEPT the Quest [Parallel Keeper] from NPC ‘Eo’ in Arcadia Realm
> Then, Parallel Metronome will be unlocked and activated.
> No need to receive or accept [Parallel Keeper] Quest again.

-  Enable to enter Parallel Metronome through NPC [Rona] in Arcadia Realm

[b]2. VALID ENTRY[/b]
* FP Consumption per Entry: FP 20
- Parallel Metronome doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Parallel Metronome has a "Valid Entry" limit.

- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit

- The number of valid entries (for NORMAL / HARD) is 9 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
- No Valid Entry Left means: No Drop or Reward Items can be obtained.
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
* Not possible to enter with Force state.

[b]3. FURTHER INFO[/b]
- Total Phase: 2
- All Players Dead and No one have 'Respawn': Not possible to obtain rewards.

> Free Respawn - [3] +2 (PLUS)

- Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] will be updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/89a57640ec574eecb44a0a610de0c310a21c43d0.png[/img]

[b][ ENTRY REQUIREMENT ][/b]
- Above Lv. 79 can enter.

[b][ VALID ENTRY ][/b]
* FP Consumption per Entry: FP 20
- Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] has a "Valid Entry" limit.

- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit

- The number of valid entries (for MANIAC) is 7 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
- No Valid Entry Left means: No Drop or Reward Items can be obtained.
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
- The number of valid entries (for MANIAC) will not be shared with valid entries (for NORMAL / HARD).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/254a36cfaa6834d50690bc16fc6f144596815405.jpg[/img]
- New Raid: TRAGIC FAIRY will be updated.

[b]▶ CHANGE – Violent Sun / Broken Savior Equipment (Slightly Easy to Craft and Upgrade)[/b]
- 'Picaresque' equipment: Craft / Upgrade will be slightly easier than before due to the update of New Weapon / Gear (Tragic Fairy Raid).

It’s the nature of the world. One thing remains, and one gone. Goodbye August and Hello September.

[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for August 18, 2022.[/b]


[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ CHANGE – The Logo of SoulWorker[/b]
- A logo will be changed to the SEASON 2 Logo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5479734436b7200e1349292553dfc9d19a0488cd.png[/img]

[b]▶ UPDATE – SoulWorker Season 2 : Road To East[/b]

> 'Life and Dignity' Quest: NPC 'Senia' → Speak to 'Toru' → Speak to 'Senia'
> 'Soldiers of Humanity' Quest: Clear [Grace Landing] Maze

- Accept 'Operation: Trench Run' Quest → Enable to move to 'Arcadia Realm' through NPC [Heitz] in Grace City.
> If you want to go to Grace City from Arcadia Realm: Enable to move to 'Grace City' through NPC [Heitz] in Arcadia Realm.

- Grace Landing Maze in the 'WEST': Can enter by using 'Operation Order: [Grace Landing]' which can obtain via 'Soldiers of Humanity' Quest.

- New Maze: [Warmingflower Farm] / [Starlight Garden] / [Giant Fear]

[b][Warmingflower Farm][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c2e4c37fbf6fb567fe7df577580367fd630c0627.png[/img]

[b][Starlight Garden][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e96c9dd2c6796f38b69316045889b548e0742349.png[/img]

[b][Giant Fear]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/14619a93fb74c4c34d6ae6ac051a7e8e253678cd.png[/img]
> How to Enter (Season 2 Mazes): Through NPC [Rona] in Arcadia Realm
> Main Story (EP 1): Can be unlocked after 'Soldiers of Humanity' Quest CLEAR (Character Level must be Lv.76 or Higher)
> Story Maze: Solo Play ONLY / Single Difficulty / 'Scenario Maze' and 'Character Maze'

- 'Spec Ops Maze' will also be updated: [Field of Raid] / [Garden of Plenty] / [Moorland of Solitude]
> Spec Ops Maze: It will be unlocked one at a time when Main Quests for Each Story Theme are entirely cleared.

[b][Spec Ops Maze][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2f24a145ea9a4d894031a700a3c41145ade0e383.png[/img]

[b][Progression of Season 2][/b]
- No Reward for each step
- Reward: Can only be obtained once
- Clear every scenario → Enable to earn all rewards
- Progression Reward of Arcadia Realm will be updated.
> Clear [Warmingflower Farm] / [Starlight Garden] / [Giant Fear] Mazes to Get 'Token' item.
> Token: Can make useful items through NPC in a certain town or district.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8084121d6c1f8ed1ec0e7da17d7b511923c0da62.png[/img]

[b][Improvement - CLEAR EXP of Season 1 Main Quests] [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/32948512d9d8910070a2f9f36c50383cacfed046.png[/img]

- Class Up / Desire Awakening Quests will be changed.
1) CLASS UP QUEST: 
> Reach Lv. 57 → NPC Activation Quest ('Fortune Corps. Landing' Quest): Activate 'Miriam' in Grasscover Camp

2) DESIRE AWAKENING QUEST:
> Corrupted Record and Desire Awakening will be separated.
> Reach Lv. 65 → Clear 'The Beginning of a New History' Quest → Accept the quest through NPC 'Brooke' in Dipluce Horizon
> Raid Clear Quests → DELETED

- Some of Season 1 Quests will be Deleted. (If your characters have following quests → Quests will be auto-canceled After Update.)
> Quests: [Maniac] Orca Forces I / II / III
> Quests: A Small Disobedience III / IV


[b]▶ CHANGE – Entry Limit of Some Mazes[/b]
- Entry Limit Change: Innocent Daydream / Second Daydream / Scary Daydream
> (Before Update) Entry Limit: 5 / PLUS: +2 
> (AFTER Update) Entry Limit: 7 / PLUS: No PLUS Bonus


[b]▶ UPDATE - Max Level & New Scenario[/b]
- Max Level Change: (Before) Lv. 76 → (After Update) Lv. 79
- New Main Quest: 22 / Each Character Quest: 9 / New Sub Quest: 4 / New Repeat Quest: 3


[b]▶ CHANGE – Ranking System[/b]
- Solo Maze Rankings will be separated 'by character' (Main Character of Users).
> Total Points Ranking: It will be counted by character based on the Main Character of Users.
> Reward: Can be received for each character.

[b][Ranking Reward Change][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5b753e5a0b3e73bef548be41a85aadf0b89cdeea.png[/img]

- Ranking Mazes: Score System and Tie-Breaker Process will be changed.
> All Ranking Maze scores are equally distributed 'by Rank' and 'by Top(%)'.
> Ranking Menu → 'Rule of Tie-Breaker': Can check more detailed information.
> In the case of tying in the final points, users with a higher rank in the Specified Ranking Maze will be ranked high.
> Specified Ranking Mazes: No.1 (Tenebris Solo) / No.2 (Flemma Solo) / No.3 (RaphaKumpa Solo)

- Ranking Reward: It will be changed to '[Ranking] Gruton Medal'.
> [Ranking] Gruton Medal: Can be exchanged to useful items at Gruton Coin Shop.

[b][Gruton Medal - Crafting Lists][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e98dd76fd93e8b2a569f1c0a8bdd10813df958fc.png[/img]

- New Solo Ranking Maze will be updated.
> Based on Broken Savior [Normal / Phase 1]

- Abyss Lounge Ranking / Team Maze Ranking will be DELETED.

- [Warp Orb] Tenebris Challenge Ticket: Using this ticket will allow Player to enter Broken Savior Solo Ranking.
> Can purchase at Gruton Coin Shop


[b]▶ UPDATE – SoulWorker [ GUIDE ][/b]
- New [ GUIDE ] System: It will provide information on Recommended Contents and Equipment for users’ current level.
> It pops up on your in-game screen ONCE A DAY / ONCE per Account when Game Login.
> It also can check at Main Menu.

- Menu of SoulWorker [Guide]: Recommended / Contents / Items / Guide

[b]
▶ UPDATE – New Skills of Characters (Lv.72 Skills)[/b]
- Lv.72 Skill will be updated to Each Character.
- HARD ARMOR effect will be applied to Lv.72 Skills.
- When using Lv.72 Skill → Buff Effect: SoulPlus Power Up 1 Time (Lv.42 Skill's SoulPlus)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6f4471fb07fc3b385c090c3df6548c11effb4e7d.png[/img]

[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Active Skill Auto-Learn / Mastery System[/b]
- Active Skills will be automatically learned when players reach a certain level.
* SoulPlus of Active Skill: Enable to 'Learn' / 'Change' / 'Cancel' in the Skill tab. (No Skill Reset item is required.)
* Passive Skill (Such as 'Tumble' / 'Retaliation'): Consume SP to learn. (Same as Season 1)
* SoulPlus: Enable to 'Learn' / 'Change' / 'Cancel' in any Districts. (Except in Mazes and District 6)

- Mastery: Consume SP to upgrade Character Stats. (Battle Mastery / Technical Mastery)
> Press Skill ( k ) button → Can find Mastery tab
> You can freely add or subtract SPs until you press the 'Apply' button of Mastery.
> SP requirement for Mastery / Passive Skill: It will be fixed to 'Consume SP 1' regardless of level.
> Skill Reset / Skill Tree Reset: SPs that used for Mastery will be reset / returned.
> Ctrl + (Mouse) Left Click: Can consume (or reset) SP 5 at once
> Shift + (Mouse) Left Click: Can consume (or reset) SP Max at once
> After Update → The max SP amount increases according to the character level.
> SPs that used before Update → ALL RESET


[b]▶ UPDATE – Cash Shop
1) NEW TAB - [Transmission] [/b]
- Transmission system (gacha) for Akashic Record / Soul Mate / Brooch / Tag will be added.
> Enable to Receive Mileage: Akashic Record / Soul Mate / Tag Transmission
> Mileage will not be provided: Brooch Transmission

 -[b] FREE Transmission Chance (Once A Day)[/b]: Akashic Record / Soul Mate (REVISED / Aug 18)

[b][Transmission (Cash Shop) - Price Info][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/cfc7f8501fdfdcc9880550f6979ec29c6073be22.png[/img]

[b]2) Shopping Cart[/b]
- (After Update) Can adjust the quantity of some items in the shopping cart.

[b]3) New & Improvement - User Convenience[/b]
- A separate notification will be exposed on the Cash Shop icon when new items are arrived.
- 'Photo' tab: Can check which photo you 'Already Own'.
- Character Preview: 'Fullscreen Mode' will be updated.
- Beauty Items: Preview Camera → Close-up the character's face
- The preview posture does not change when the character is wearing a weapon costume.
- Preview: Can check the character's general/battle gestures.
- Event Cash & Normal Cash: Event Cash is used in preference to Normal Cash.


[b]▶ CHANGE - Mileage Store[/b]
- How to obtain Mileage: (Present) Purchase PKGs that provide Mileages → (After Update) Through Transmission system (Cash Shop) for Akashic Record / Soul Mate / Tag
> PKGs that provide Mileages will be DELETED from Cash Shop.
> Using Transmission system 1 time → Can obtain 'Mileage 1'

- Mileage Store (Gruton Coin Shop): New Sales Tabs will be updated.
> Soul Mate (Mileage) / Tag (Mileage) will be added.
> Akashic Record Mileage Shop: Parable's High-Grade A.R Transmitter and Parable's Hidden A.R Transmitter will be added.
> (After August 18th Update) Mileage will NOT reset at all. (No Monthly Reset)

- Akashic Record Mileage Shop: Purchase Limit and Price will be changed.
> Parable's A.R Transmitter: (Present) Purchase Limit: 10 times per Month / Price: Mileage 6 → (After Update) Purchase Limit: No Purchase Limit / Price: Mileage: 5
> Parable's A.R Transmitter [★4]: (Present) Price: Mileage 13 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 50
> A.R Card Special Select Option [★4] I: (Present) Price: Mileage 50 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 160
> Parable's A.R Transmitter [★5]: (Present) Price: Mileage 65 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 220
> A.R Card Special Select Option [★5] I: (Present) Price: Mileage 100 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 320
> Parable's High-Grade A.R Transmitter: Mileage 15 
> Parable's Hidden A.R Transmitter: Mileage 10

- Your mileage will increase x3.2 times after August 18th Update. (Decimal Point will be deleted / No round off)


[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Soul Mate[/b]
- Soul Mate is a companion of SoulWorkers. They can do Auto-Loot (items) and provide Buffs to SoulWorkers!
- [ Y ] button is the shortcut key in the game.
- Soul Mate: Account Basis (Soul Mates will show for all characters on your account.)

[b]1) How to Obtain[/b]
- Can obtain through 'Soul Mate Box'.
- Gather 'Memory Fragment' → 'Release' to obtain
- Cash Shop: Through Soul Mate 'Transmission' system in Cash Shop
- Not possible to hold same Soul Mates: If you obtain existing Soul Mate again → it is automatically converted to a "Memory Fragment"
- Memory Fragment can be purchased at 'Fragment Shop' (Soul Mate Menu) with 'Colorless Memory Fragment: Pet'.

[b]2) Memory Fragment: Soul Mate[/b]
- Use 'Memory Fragment' to raise a Soul Mate's Rank.
- Can purchase at 'Fragment Shop' (Soul Mate Menu) / 'Gruton Coin Shop' (Mileage Store - Soul Mate) / 'Cash Shop' (Transmission - Soul Mate)
- If a Soul Mate's Rank reach MAX:
> Not possible to obtain Memory Fragments of Max Ranked Soul Mate.
> Can obtain 'Colorless Memory Fragment: Pet' instead.

[b]3) Summon / Companion[/b]
- Summon: Can summon a Soul Mate that you choose.
- Companion: (e.g.) Summon 'Haru' Soul Mate and Companion 'Erwin' Soul Mate → 'Erwin' Soul Mate follows you but the buffs of 'Haru' Soul Mate is applied to your character.
- Summon / Dismiss: Possible to do in any Districts.
- In the Maze: If you forget to summon a Soul Mate, you can't summon in the maze. You must summon a Soul Mate BEFORE you enter a maze. ('Dismiss' is not possible, either.)
- Not possible to summon any Soul Mates in ‘District 6’.

[b]4) RANK of Soul Mates[/b]
- Soul Mate Rank: Total of 20 Ranks (C ~ SSS) / Each Soul Mate has a different starting rank.
- Use 'Memory Fragment' to raise a Soul Mate's Rank.
- Rank Up → Soul Mate's Stats will be increased. (Some Soul Mates increase their Stats per Level.)
- Soul Mate 'Story' & 'Voice': Can be unlocked by Rank Up.
- Rank C / Rank B / Rank A: Enable to rank up to ★3
- Rank S / Rank SS: Enable to rank up to ★5
- Rank SSS: MAX RANK (No higher rank exists.)

[b]5) Rename Soul Mate[/b]
 - Can rename your Soul Mates by using 'Soul Mate Name Change' item. (Can purchase at Cash Shop)

[b]6) Level of Soul Mate[/b]
- Soul Mate can obtain EXP as much as FP has consumed AFTER MAZE CLEAR.
- Not possible to get any EXP if leaving without clearing the maze.
- Level Up → Soul Mate's Stats will be increased. (Some Soul Mates increase their Stats per Rank.)

[b]7) Stats of Soul Mate[/b]
- Stats will be increased by Rank / Level.
- 'Max Stats' Button: Enable to check Rank SSS / Lv.30 Stats of Soul Mate

[b][Soul Mate - Stats][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/426c1f92b9e6038fe34073880f6d0109afa92aa0.png[/img]

[b]8) Skills of Soul Mate[/b]
- Soul Mates have their own skill.
- Soul Mates have the same Skill regardless of rank. (EXCEPT FOR Betty / Arua / Yorhaka / Poison)

[b][Soul Mate - Skills][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/65c6f212f742f35cfb34e56d0915254374ef93ec.png[/img]

[b]9) Artifacts of Soul Mate[/b]
- Can equip Max 3 Artifacts that increase the Stats of user's Character. (Applies ONLY when the Artifacts-equipped Soul Mate is summoned.)
- Artifacts: BLUE / RED (Can be unlocked Lv.15) / EFFECT (Can be unlocked Lv.30)
> Effect Artifact: Equip Effect Artifact → creates a unique effect around the Soul Mate.
- Artifact Grade: Normal (Lowest) / Magic / Rare / Unique / Legend (Highest)
- Can obtain through Transmission system (Cash Shop).
- Also, chance to obtain at 'Moorland of Solitude' (Season 2)

[b][Soul Mate Artifact - Lists & Stats][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2a9cb1aad2278b9c06fa4509a43199aac61d8dae.png[/img]

[b]10) Artifact Combine / Dismantle[/b]
- Combine Artifacts: Can obtain Same Grade Artifacts or Higher Grade Artifacts
> When Combine → Add Artifact x1 → Result: Same Grade Artifact
> To get Higher Grade Artifacts: When Combine, Need to add Certain Amounts of Artifacts.
- Can combine with Same Grade Artifacts (Success Chance: 100%)
- Dismantle Artifacts: Can obtain 'Colorless Memory Fragment: Pet' that allows you to purchase various Memory Fragment of Soul Mates.

[b]11) Stories of Soul Mate[/b]
- Some Soul Mates can unlock their own Stories per Rank.
- Can check which Rank that you can unlock the story. (Soul Mate menu)

[b]12) Voices of Soul Mate[/b]
- Rank A or Higher Rank Soul Mates have their own Voices and can be activated in Special Conditions.
> Voice Conditions can be checked at Soul Mate menu - [Voice]
> Special Conditions of Voice: Some Soul Mates (Haru / Erwin / Lily / Jin / and so on) and Rank S or Higher Rank Soul Mates have their own Special Condition Voices.
> Voice function can be activated from Rank S of Soul Mate.


[b]▶ NEW PREMIUM COSTUME[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/536efb16abc3181f603ca12eee1c04cd607a9ff3.png[/img]

[b]▶ CHANGE – PROGRESSION REWARD[/b]

* e.g.) Rocco Town Token: This Unique Currency is issued to SoulWorkers who have cleared mazes in the Rocco Town area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6175be722a1c34cc5772f361753890c817e9e5c9.png[/img]

[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for April 28, 2022.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ MAINTENANCE ◆--------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ SERVER MAINTENANCE RECAP[/b]

[b]- New Raid: 'Broken Savior'
- Soul Pass Season 4

- Changes and Fixes[/b]
> Fix some error issues

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ GRAND NEW RAID – [BROKEN SAVIOR][/b]
- Broken Savior will be added.
- This Raid is for 1 ~ 4 Players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/df4ee2401a13c8ba67df6284b2edd28796ca90b0.jpg[/img]

[b][How To Enter]
-  Raid for Scenario[/b]
> Complete the Main Quest [Overwhelming Power] → Speak to NPC [Toru] → Receive the Quest [How To Cut Off The Monster's Head]
( ※ Haru Estia / Erwin Arclight: Must clear the Quest [Prepare To Cut Off That Monster's Head] first → then, enable to receive the Quest [How To Cut Off The Monster's Head] )
> During the Quest: Use a Warp Item "Operation Order: [Broken Savior]" to enter Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/15c52d9c1006333872bbafbb3a0878d1991bc239.jpg[/img]

> Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid' (For Main Quest): 1 Player can play and clear this Scenario Raid.
> This Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid' will not be able to enter after completing the Main Quest.

[b]- Entering the Raid for the First Time[/b]
> After receive the New Quest [Peace in the West... And...] → NPC [Arin] of Grace City: "Transport to the Maze" → Can enter Broken Savior

[b][Number of Valid Entries][/b]
- Broken Savior doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Broken Savior has a "Valid Entry" limit.
- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
- Valid Entry Limit will be Reset Weekly. (Account Base)
- The number of valid entries is 20 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
> 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play: Drop Item Rewards are only available for players with Valid Entries remaining.
> (e.g.) 3 players - A, B, C players
A - Valid Entry: 3 (Can obtain rewards) / B - Valid Entry: 0 (No rewards) / C - Valid Entry: 1 (Can obtain rewards)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4e703e794dbf35caa9ec04ee13e76c3c1deab989.jpg[/img]

- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
- Solo Play and 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play are available.
- Not possible to enter with Force status.

[b][More About Broken Savior][/b]

- Total Phase: 2
> Must clear Phase 1 within a fixed time to enter Phase 2.
- A reward can be changed according to the Phase that is cleared. 
> (e.g.) [Broken Savior] Phase 1 Conquer Box / [Broken Savior] Phase 2 Conquer Box
> [Broken Savior] Conquer Box: Must destroy this box to see the Raid Clear Result.
- All Players Dead and No one have 'Respawn': Not possible to obtain rewards.
- Respawn Limit:
> Free Respawn - [3] +2 (PLUS)
> Respawn (with Items) - [3]
> Cash Respawn - [Unlimited]
- Not possible to use ACTIVE Akashic Record
- 6 Main Quests will be added. (Exclusive Quest for Haru / Erwin: 1)
- 1 Repeat Quest will be added.
> Repeat Quest: Grace City → Speak to [Worker Support Device: Merchants' Union] in NPC [Arin]'s direction → [Quest] Tab → Can purchase 'Broken Savior Mission Receiver' (30,000 Zenny)
> Broken Savior Mission Receiver: Can purchase Once a day per Account / Repeat Quest - Can accept and complete Once a day
※ Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid': Not included in the number of Repeat Quests completed.
- New Achievement / Progress for Broken Savior will be added.
- New Crafting Materials will be added.
 > Fragment of Distorted Justice / Essence of Distorted Justice

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0b537758ee1a24415f53013d7b96884833e8aaf2.png[/img]
※ Character Profile → Raid Section of Worker Account / Character Info Note: It will be changed when Broken Savior [Hard] Mode is updated.

[b]NEW WEAPON / GEAR / ACCESSORY[/b]
- Broken Savior Raid Reward Box: Can obtain "Picaresque" Weapons and Gears with a certain probability.
> Phase 1 Drop - "Picaresque" Weapons with a certain probability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2dd01f5cba2cb62d0ded9d2005f929acf2db8373.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for January 27, 2022.
[/b]
[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. NEW SYSTEM: EQUIPMENT SUCCESSION (WEAPON / GEAR)[/b]
- Succession: Can implant some of upgrade stats and options in the equipment from the upper raid into the higher tier equipment.

- How to Use
> Which NPC: NPC [Trisha] from each district
> Which Equipment: Above Lv.68 and LEGEND equipment
> Put down the equipment that you want to succeed → Can check a list of equipment that can receive Succession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9bb26382cc835aa05c6c8c3ad5180f4e6f9ff303.png[/img]

> Which Equipment can provide Succession: Upgrade Stat at least +3 equipment
> Which Equipment can receive Succession: Equipment that has No Upgrade Stat
> The "Succession Number" will be added to the equipment that can receive Succession.
> Succession-Provide Equipment: It should not contain any Familiar / Soulstone. Can use Succession after extract Familiar / Soulstone.
> Equipment equipped with non-extractable LEGEND or Higher Familiar: Can provide Succession. Equipment and Familiar will be deleted after Succession process.
> To use Succession: Require "Succession Device" item. This can be crafted through NPC [Janice].
> Succession of Upgrade Stats: the upgrade stat value will be reduced (value: -3) when it is implanted.
> Succession of Random Options: Can implant only one option. However, the option's stat value will be randomly determined.
> Not allow to provide options that Equipment is not possible to have.
> Option lists that Succession Receive Equipment can take: Enable to check through the 'Option Info' button.
> Not allow to receive duplicate options.
> When options are all the same between Succession Provide and Receive Equipment → Only Upgrade Stat Value will succeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5a978afad704b64eec6297f954fe57da56c49d16.png[/img]

> 'Upgrade-Protection Memory' item can alleviate decreasing upgrade stat value. Can purchase at Cash Shop.
> 'Add-Option Memory' item allows you to implant up to two options. Can purchase at Cash Shop.

However, after a careful internal investigation, it has been confirmed that ★5’s drop rate of Parable's A.R Transmitter is currently set as 2.4%. Various other drop rates have been thoroughly checked and no other issues have been found except Parable's Akashic Record Transmitter. 

We truly apologize for causing concerns to all users with unstable services. After the Parable's A.R Transmitter update, several other special A.R Transmitters were released. Those A.R Transmitter have also been checked entirely, and the ★5's drop rate of those was set as accurate as 1.2%. Since those transmitters had informed that there was the same drop rate as Parable's A.R Transmitter, the following compensation will be provided to users who purchased the issued A.R Transmitter below.

The details are as follows:
- Eligible for Compensation: Users who have purchased 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter / Halloween Special A.R Transmitter and related products

- Compensation in detail: Parable's A.R Transmitter will be provided as equal as each user has purchased 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter / Halloween Special A.R Transmitter before the update.

e.g.) If purchased: 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter PKG III x2 / 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter x 5 / Halloween Special A.R Transmitter x3

> Parable's A.R Transmitter (55+55+5+3) 118 will be provided.

- Compensation Date: After the update of December 9, 2021

★5’s drop rate of Parable's A.R Transmitter will be adjusted while December’s First Update is taken. 
The rate will be changed from 2.4% to 1.2% as same as with other transmitters. 

Once again, we sincerely apologize for any caused inconvenience and will try to provide a fair environment for your gameplay.
Thank you.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6175be722a1c34cc5772f361753890c817e9e5c9.png[/img]


Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for November 11, 2021.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. LEAGUE SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- The display method of league members will be changed.
- [Members] Tab Sorting: Members, who are currently logged in, will show at the top.
- League Fund: Unit classification marks will be added.
- The indication position of league skill will be changed below the league fund.
- The display method of league announcement will be changed.
- The title bar of the league window will be changed to display a name of the league.
- 'League Emblem Change' Ticket: Enable to check at the League Master Menu → [League Emblem] Tab
 > New League Marks / Emblems will be added.
- The location of 'Message' (League Search) will be changed. Enable to find at the League Master Menu → [Rights] Tab.
- The location of 'Leave' button will be changed to the top of the league member.
- New Function: Reset All League Skills
 > League skills will be able to reset by using the League Fund.
 > Can be used by the League Master only. Require 3,000,000 League Fund to use Reset All League Skills.

[b][League Attendance][/b]
- Attendance Rewards: Individual attendance + League Members' attendance on each day of the week
- Attendance Check Reset: 01:00 (GMT) every day
 > It will be checked that who will receive an extra reward when attendance is reset. If the conditions are satisfied, Attendance reward + Extra reward (Previous day) can be obtained.
 > The reward will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.

[b][League Shop][/b]
- How To Use: Find NPC [Seres] - 'Shop' function
- Can purchase with the League Fund only.
- Item purchases can be made regardless of positions in the League.
- Each item has daily purchase restrictions per character.
- There is no [Buyback] tab. Sell and Dismantle are also not possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9658d6ebb36da8c67975ff8d1f5a4a9f3831871d.png[/img]

[b]2. MAZE FOR LEAGUE - ‘LEGION INVADER’[/b]

[b][Entry Requirements][/b]
- Above Lv. 55 can enter.
- Only the Same League Members are enabled to enter this maze.

[b][How To Enter][/b]
- The League [Master / Vice Master / Admin] can open the maze at any time of the week.
- It requires 10,000 Zenny (League Fund) to activate the maze.
- The maze can be activated twice a week. It lasts 48 hours after the maze is activated.
- 1 ~ 4 player parties can enter.
- Each member can enter only once when activated.
- For 2 ~ 4 player parties, only the Team Leader can apply for entry to the maze.
- Activation Weekly Reset: Mondays at 01:00 (GMT)
- Unable to activate 30 minutes before the activation weekly reset time and the activated maze will also be closed.

[b][About Maze][/b]
- The maze runs for a total of 5 minutes only, and it automatically ends after 5 minutes.
- There is a total of 15 phases of monster defeat.
- Enable to gain a score assigned to monsters when defeating monsters.
- No scores on monsters that are automatically killed when the maze ends.
- 'My Score' can be found in league records and the league raid activation button.
- The total score obtained by the league members will be initialized on a weekly basis.
- Enable to use Active/Passive Akashic Records.
- No limit to use Respawn.
- No Item / Zenny / Ether drops. Also, no EXP / SV gains.
- A member who has participated the league raid cannot be expelled or leave from the League until the maze is deactivated.

[b][Rewards][/b]
- League Raid Coin is the reward. Enable to purchase items with this coin from NPC [Seres].
- The League Raid Reward will be given according to individual clear score. It will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b0c849a7139c0c479e42b37b9e4d8bf8208d0a85.png[/img]

notes.title: [Notice] World Boss Closing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/92dc2400b43404a93ece1df73fe2c3b6ced82bb3.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker. 

We are fully acknowledged that our users continuously expect the World Boss in Tenebris (EN) server that has been opened since May 13th.
The World Boss, as a time-limited content, is required much participation to defeat a huge scale of Boss, providing incomparable experience and following high quality of rewards. 
With all due respect, there are many difficulties of providing the contents in our current servers in regard to its specialty as the multiplayer-fighting content, and simultaneous accessibility from each far area/country. 
Even though we have done our best to provide the World Boss to users in Tenebris (EN) server, we concluded that it will not be able to service the contents mentioned above in a smooth environment.

As a consequence, system change will be applied to the World Boss-based rewards, enabling them to be obtainable in a different way.
SoulWorker Team sincerely apologizes for such inconvenience. 
Details are as follows:

[b]1)  Stay Connected Reward:[/b]
- Rewards for being played for 90 minutes will be replaced with the new boosting item.
The boosting will be the same benefit as 50 times defeat of The Doom and removed after 48 hours after receiving the item. Also, it can be duplicated with another boosting.
- Benefit: 
[Item Drops +25%] + [Monster Defeat EXP +15%] + [Zenny Drops +10%] 
+ [Maze Clear EXP +10%] (Duration: 60 minutes)
- Regarding this change, the previous rewards for both 30 and 60 minutes will be partially modified and the total of Stay Connected rewards will also be better supplied compared to the past. 

[b]2) Daily Mission [/b]
- Previous World Boss-based drops can be received from the completion of Daily Mission that will be newly applied. 
Reward: [District Brooch Transducer x5] + [Gear Extension x5] + [Weapon Extension x5] + [Ultimate Etherite  x2] + [BP/Familiar Random Box  x1]
- The requirement for the daily mission will be the completion of ‘Violent Sun 3 times’ and it will be continuously changed to the hardest following raid.
- With the system change mentioned above, weekly crafting restriction for Brooch from NPC [Eo] will be newly added.

All information in detail will be applied to both Rosca (TC) and Tenebris (EN) servers and planned to be conducted in the middle of October.
When being applied, the playable World Boss in Rosca (TC) will be coming to an end.
Throughout this modification applied to our system from limited contents to general gameplay, any characters bearing with Violent Sun will also get all rewards from World Boss.
Regarding this change, our goal is to provide a more comfortable and faster-reacted environment to our users. Further details will be announced on our official upcoming update note.
SoulWorker Team sincerely apologizes again for the inconvenience concerning World Boss playing, and we are looking forward that this change will be more helpful for all users’ smooth gameplay.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Restriction on Unusual Trade
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/58d91bfae0aebe3c4bfde577353b240ad12d7618.png[/img]

Hello, this is SoulWorker Operation Team. 

Investigations have been conducted for such violations concerning illegal program use and unusual trade of in-game currency. Although no information in detail has been announced, restrictions have been imposed on accounts in relation to such actions mentioned above. 
The reason for investigating the Market trade record and that of Zenny is to prevent Real Money Trading (RMT) and stabilize the Market system. 

Details are as follows: 
1. Overpriced item that has been sold above the average worth (higher than 30%) of the same item.
2. Trades committed with a very large amount of Zenny without any items. 
3. Trading with illegal Program Users
4. Trade regarding a large amount of Zenny with unidentified resources, and exceptional trading records/etc. 
5. Restrictions will also be given to previous trade when being confirmed as a violation mentioned above. 

When being confirmed, Permanent Suspension will be given to those regarding such action followed by Operational Policy. No further measures will be applied to the consequence. 

We ask all users to stop being interacted with Real Money Trading and unusual Zenny Trade. 
SoulWorker Team will always try to ensure a Fair Environment for your gameplay. 

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] 210902 Update Note Preview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2dd01f5cba2cb62d0ded9d2005f929acf2db8373.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Information about 2021 September 2nd Updates taking place can be found below.

--------------------------------------------◆ Update ◆---------------------------------------------------
[b]1. New Raid ‘Violent Sun’[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/743869f8ed4f6f5d80ea33728b02023bfce33e69.png[/img]
- The new raid ‘Violent Sun’ will be newly added. (1~4 players) 

[Requirement]
- Players above level 72 can only be accessible.
- You can access ‘Violent Sun’ when proceeding and accepting the main quest ‘Crimson March III’
> The quest ‘Crimson March III can be conducted from ‘Crimson March I’ after completing ‘Unforgivable Past’

[How to Access]
- You can access the raid using ‘Maze Selection Warp System’ from NPC [Arin] in Grace City. 

[Daily Access Limitation]
- The raid ‘Violent Sun’ will be restricted to three times per character a day. 
- The access can be reset using [Access Pass] Violent Sun. 
- Party based from 1~4 players.

[Raid Information] 
- There are 3 phases in Violent Sun. 
- If you have failed to defeat Flemma in time from the 1st and 2nd phase in Violent Sun, the battle will be ended when defeating Flemma you have currently fought against. 
> The [Violent Sun Reward PKG] will be appeared if the battle did not further proceed and finished in a certain phase from the 1st to the 3rd. 
> When all players being died, rewards will not be obtainable if unable to revive. 
> The result table will appear after the destruction of the PKG mentioned above. 

- The resurrection counts are limited to three in Violent Sun Raid using the resurrector. (Being resurrected in different ways will not be counted.)
- Active Akashic Records cannot be used in Violent Sun Raid.
- The Boss ‘Flemma’ will not be influenced with extra damage status inflicted to Rapid Flame Vessi.
- Three main quests and one repeat quest concerning Violent Sun will be newly added. (Main Quest Exceptions for Lee Nabi)
> The repeat quest can be dealt with by purchasing [Violent Sun Mission Receiver] with 30,000 Zenny from the Worker Support Device: Merchant Union’s [Quest] tab stood next to [Senia] in Grace City. (Purchasable once per character a day)

- Crafting materials are newly added below:
> Fused Desire Crystal, Burning/Pale Embers, Pale Fragment, Hardening Catalyst
 - Progression Rate and rewards for Violent Sun will be newly added.

[Equipment Information] 
- New Weapon, Gear, and Accessory series ‘Pale Ashes’ can be obtained with a random possibility to clear the ‘Violent Sun’. 
- 5 Set Options will be available from the ‘Pale Ashes’ equipment series. (No concern to its category – Standard/Extend/Hero but any 4 Pale Ashes Gear + Pale Ashes Weapon)  
- Level 72 Familiar ‘Faint Light Desire’ will be newly added and can be crafted from NPC [Maxime]; can also be dismantled or recrafted.

[Additional Information]
- The Pale Ashes Frames can be obtained with a random probability to clear the ‘Violent Sun’.
 > The Pale Ashes Standard Weapon/Gear can be obtained when using it and can be tradable if not being opened.
> Obtainable from [Crafting].

- The Pale Ashes Hero Weapon/Gear can be obtained with the extremely low probability to clear the 3rd Phase of ‘Violent Sun’.
- The Hero Weapon will be obtained as ‘Pale Ashes Hero Weapon Box’ and gears are full-made. 
> When opened, the Hero Weapon that suits the character will be distributed.
> The ‘Pale Ashes Hero Weapon Box’ will be obtained by accomplishing a certain achievement.

- ‘Burning Ember’ will be obtained when dismantling Standard/Extend equipment.
- ‘Pale Ember’ will be obtained when dismantling Hero equipment.
- ‘Pale Ashes’ equipment can be obtained using those ‘Embers’ as a crafting material.
- ‘Pale Fragment’ can only be obtained from the 3rd phase of Violent Sun and used as a crafting material of ‘Pale Ember’.
- ‘Hardening Catalyst’ can be purchased with BP from NPC [Bucker TV] and used as a crafting material of ‘Pale Ember’.
- the volume of chatting has been adjusted smaller in Altar of Void, Hidden Hideout, Day-dream themed mazes, and Violent Sun. (September 6th Updated)

[b]2. New Akashic Record [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8915297708b5577aaa881af936d74ad8483f6143.jpg[/img]
- New ★5 Akashic Record ‘Kent, god of Governance’ will be newly added.
- ‘Kent, god of Governance’ can be obtained from ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f988a0130f284aeb3e3250a0ed13b2d394d8ffb4.png[/img]
- The [Kent] will be newly added to A.R Special Select Option, and Parable’s A.R Transmitter [★5] that can be purchased from Mileage Shop after UPDATE. 
[h3][u][b]* Please be notified that Kent will not be selectable for the Select Option and Transmitter mentioned above purchased before update. [/b][/u][/h3]

[b]3. Parable’s A.R Transmitter [/b]
- Upcoming Akashic Records including Kent will be obtained from ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’ and unobtainable from the previous ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’. 
-  All of in-game ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’ will be replaced as ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter.
-  Previous owned items are not replaced. 
-  Details are as follows:
 > Boss (es) Drops 
 > Attendance/ Stay Connected Reward 
 > Sales on Gruton Coin Shop 
 > Daily Mission Reward 
> Special Reward (Returnee reward, SoulWorker Sprint and Leveling Package Reward) 
* No modification applied to Progression Reward: ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’ will be obtainable from the upcoming contents.

 - ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’-related packages will be newly registered as ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter PKG’ 
- No modification applied to items purchased previously.
- Details are as follows: 
 > NEW Beginner PKG I, II, III
 > Challenger PKG
 > A.R Transmitter PKG I, II, III, III+
 > A.R Transmitter Starter PKG I, II

- Parable’s A.R Transmitter will be newly added to the crafting list of NPC [Eo]

[b]4. Other Modification[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9bab3f5695c3015349afa4c862f36e7a3849e957.png[/img]
- Changes to the Login Screen will be made.
- The summer-themed infrastructures will be removed in Grace City. 
- The clear records of Hidden Hideout will be changed to that of the 3rd Phase in Violent Sun. 
- Incorrect descriptions in the [Help] tab have been edited.
- Chatting/Name filters will be updated. 
- ‘Additional Collection Guideline Manual [10M] will be newly added to NPC [Gruton Coin Shop] 
> Drops will be increased by 50% when using it and it can be duplicated with Lucky Day or other Manual-named items. 

- An error regarding Haru, Erwin, Lily, Jin’s Milk Cow Outfit gesture has been fixed. 
- An error regarding the tooltip of Chii’s Bloodbath has been fixed. No modification applied to the skill itself. 
- The deletion of character will now be required 336 hours (14 days – Previous in 24 hours [1 day])
- An error regarding Stella’s cinema talk has been fixed. (EN Only) 

-----------------------------------------◆ Events ◆----------------------------------------------------

[b]1. [Flemma Random Box Daily Mission Event] will be carried out. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update) [/b]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7adcdb549abfe51a1ebfc5934a039625bb2fb588.png[/img]

[b]Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Information about 2021 July 8th Updates taking place can be found below.[/b]

[b]--------------------------------------------◆ Updates ◆-------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. Costume Re-packaging System (Costume Wrapping) [/b]
- A new function of repacking individual costume parts stored in your Fashion inventory will be newly added. 
- Costumes can be re-packed as a package to use ‘Costume Wrapping’ when all Costume parts are owned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6fea537fc00b434caca88e428d7598fb84da0cf6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/17c50411c7c1c2a2045c54951c0393026643266e.png[/img]

- Re-packaging will only be available for SoulCash-purchased costumes. 
- Costumes with brooches can be re-packed when the brooches get removed. 
- Dyed Costumes can be re-packed again, remained as dyed color.
- The package will be tradable or possessed when being re-packed. 
> [b]Assuming that there are any costume parts possessed:[/b] The package will be possessed and untradeable; all costumes become possessed when reopening it.
> [b]Assuming that there is any costume parts unequipped:[/b] The package will be tradable, and all costumes become tradable when reopening it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/263624c4f24c8ad7626fa02c116f1ab30839d02f.png[/img]

- It will be easier to recognize Unpacked/Re-packed Costumes mentioned above: 
- Costume packages will be purchasable in [Costume] – [Costume Package] Category when being registered to the Market.
☞ Our Operational Policy for costumes will be modified with the new function of the re-packaging system. (Costume Wrapping)
- SoulCash-purchased costumes will not be possessed until being unpacked. 
- SoulCash-purchased costume packages can be tradeable itself after purchasing them.
- Re-packable Costumes can be re-packed indefinitely.
> Please be notified that some costumes cannot be re-packed when included in the package; Limitations will exist for those costumes. 
- SoulCash-purchased costumes cannot be refunded when being unpacked or traded in the Market.

[b]2. New Akashic Record[/b]
- ★5 for [Lucy], ★4 for [Sedurin], and [Senia] will be newly added. 
> Those limited editions mentioned above can only be obtained in [2021 One Summer Day's Special Akashic Record Transmitter].

notes.title: [Notice] 2021 July Update Preview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7adcdb549abfe51a1ebfc5934a039625bb2fb588.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Information about 2021 July Updates taking place can be found below.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆Preview◆---------------------------------------------------[/b]
[b]☞ July 1st Update [/b]

[b]▶ Costume Re-packaging System[/b]
- A new function of repacking costumes that have been already obtained will be newly added. 
- The package will be tradable or possessed based on being equipped or not when being unpacked. 
 > Assuming that there are costumes possessed:  
 The package will be possessed. All costumes become possessed when reopening it. 
 > Assuming that there are costumes unequipped: 
 The package will be tradable. All costumes become tradable when reopening it. 
 
- All costumes enabled to apply the repackaging system can be sealed infinitely when the new function has been applied to the in-game system.
 > Event costumes, Individual costumes (Example: Wings) will not be repacked.

[b]☞ July 2nd Update[/b]
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/880ab8ae7cacc0d15a5283623b21e3fd89381278.png[/img]

[b]▶ The 9th SoulWorker, Lee Nabi[/b]

- The 9th SoulWorker, “Lee Nabi” will be newly added.
 > Class Up and Desire Awakening can be played through the 9th SoulWorker, Lee Nabi.

[b]- Character Synopsis[/b]
Everything disappeared in the blink of an eye.
A massive… something… took my house, people important to me, my life and everything around me; 
 it wiped out everything in my life.
I couldn’t save them; I couldn’t rescue them; I didn’t even have the courage to go in after them. 
I was nothing more than a breathing corpse… standing there not being able to do anything.
Unable to move, I stood there crying inside, waiting for someone to rescue me. 

Oh, you poor child, it looks like you've been through so much. 
You don't need to think about anything, my sweet; fall soundly asleep in my arms.
Don't think about how it started or how it ended; I will tell you everything you need to know.
Put away all thoughts while in your little cocoon.
Keep your eyes closed a bit longer, and before you know it, you'll emerge a beautiful butterfly spreading your majestic wings.

[b][Order of Lord “QuadStella TriSilva”][/b]
Being at the head of Starry Forest League, these “Four Stars and Three Forests” act upon maintaining everything in this world. Their title represents not only Starry Forest League’s but humanity’s safety in them being their stars and forests. Although not many people have sighted them being hidden in the depths of their East Headquarters and taking care of matters within, QuadStella TriSilva have slowly started revealing themselves to the outside world after the release of their 2nd Generation SoulWorkers. Stars represent the protectors of humanity, while Forests represent war heroes of the battlefields.

[b][Bernard’s Special Missions Unit][/b]
In order to scout the West, SoulWorker “Ain” has changed his name to “Bernard” and has created a “Special Missions Unit” filled with 2nd Generation SoulWorkers under the order of Lords.
They prioritize superior orders before objective reasoning and start investigating SoulWorkers.
“Hero Armor” who calls himself the world’s hero covered in steel armor along with
“Varbir” who deems himself a savior of the world, spreading peace unto everyone
And many other 2nd Generation SoulWorkers with their own morals go on an adventure together.

[b][2nd Generation SoulWorkers][/b]
2nd Generation SoulWorkers have been trained for ten years by the Headquarters of Starry Forest League to become as strong and as similar to real SoulWorkers. While they are capable of performing as much Energy as real SoulWorkers for but a moment, unlike real SoulWorkers who perform infinite Soul Energy without any limitations, they become exhausted, feeling fatigued and hunger after a few battles due to Soul Energy consumption; they must rejuvenate themselves through rest and food. What Starry Forest League decides to create the 2nd generation..  


Please look forward to our July Update.
Thank you.

※ The scheduled update may be subject to change due to internal circumstances.

日前發現TC伺服器內，使用作為去年台港澳開服活動獎勵之升級禮包時，會有額外出現全球服開服紀念新生成帳號禮物的錯誤現象。

[詳細內容]
1. 對象：持有去年10/3 台港澳開服活動之升級禮包，並於今年5/13後使用之玩家，共150位 – TC伺服器

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7adcdb549abfe51a1ebfc5934a039625bb2fb588.png[/img]

[b]Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Information about June 10th Updates and events taking place can be found below. [/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ Updates ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

1. Skill Balance Update: Chii Aruel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f3608934bc8296b1b28ee89f5baff09c4e724d8d.png[/img]

[b]2. Other Modifications[/b]
- An error regarding Ephnel’s ‘Bullet’ UI has been fixed. 
- Monster Drops from Raid Maze will not be influenced by Player Level Difference.
> Maze: Casual Raid, Golden Citadel, The Primal, The Primal (Hero), Altar of Void, Hidden Hideout, Lunar Fall 
- Errors regarding changing Chii & Ephnel’s appearance (Hairstyle) have been fixed. 
- An error regarding the position of Stella’s Winter Costume Weapon has been fixed.
- Characters in preview no longer pose as Hold. 
- Errors regarding the irregular status applied when equipping FOT Brooch effects and the title ‘White Knight’ simultaneously have been fixed. 
- An error regarding the UI notification of The Primal (Hero) in The Primal Entrance UI has been fixed.
- An error regarding the additional effect of Haru’s First Blade when learning its SoulPlus has been fixed.
- An error regarding Yorhaka’s HP and Maze progress in the 1st~2nd phase (Altar of Void) has been fixed. 
- An error regarding Megiddo Maker II receiving no damage has been fixed. 
- Normal / Bright / Sunlight skin tooltips have been adjusted. No physical changes were applied. 
- [Jin] A graphic error regarding equipping socks & stockings with brown pants has been fixed.
- [Stella] A graphic error regarding her sitting motion has been fixed.
- [Stella] A graphic error regarding equipping Silver/Gold bell choker has been fixed. 
- [Erwin] Skill tooltip videos have been enhanced. No actual changes were applied. 
- [Stella] Sound synchronizations of Red Orchestra Costume have been adjusted. 
- Monthly/Weekly attendance records have been modified. (EN –Tenebris Server Only) 

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ Events ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/aeb5902403c1d61a2da2a8adb8e28ffa35483246.jpg[/img]

[b]1. The Maze event [Soul Jumper] will be carried out (After updates on June 10th ~ before June 24th updates)[/b]
- A Special Maze named Soul Jumper will be added (Move & Jump only to clear) 
> The maze event will be available after updates on June 10th ~ before updates on 24th

[b][Access] [/b]
- Players above Lv.30 can enter the maze to purchase [Warp Orb: Entertainment Soul Jumper] from 
Gruton Coin Shop.
> Daily purchase will be limited to twice a day, using 10 Gruton coins to purchase.
> Players above Lv.30 can use [Warp Orb: Entertainment Soul Jumper] only. 
> Players can access Soul Jumper with no cost to use [EV: Merchants Union Flyer] when progressing quest [Entertainment: Soul Jumper].

[b][Progress] [/b]
- Players are required to clear the Soul Jumper Maze using jump and dash jump only. No skills are available. 
- The structure will be straight-shaped: Rewards will be located in destinations of each difficulty and divided among three categories [Normal], [Hard], [Maniac] 
> Being proceeded as clear when operating the clear cube. 
> Being unable to operate other clear cubes in different destinations when already operating one. 
> Rewards will appear when operating the clear cube.
-Using jump orbs to progress the Maze Soul Jumper.
> Green Orb: Granting double-jump (Duration: 1 sec) 
> Blue Orb: Granting higher double-jump (Duration: 1 sec) 
> Golden Orb: Granting highest double-jump (Duration: 1 sec) 
> Red Orb: Fall down to the bottom when obtaining it
- No time limits to clear the maze. 
- No try limits to restart the maze from starting point.
- The checkpoint will be activated when reaching a particular point of [Normal], [Hard].
- Players will be automatically teleported to the starting point when falling down. 
>The starting point is to begin your challenge in each difficulty. No checkpoints available for [Maniac]. 

[b][Reward][/b]
- Upon clearing the Maze Soul Jumper, [EV] Soul Jumper Coins x50 and [EV] ‘You are the Jump King’ Package in each difficulty will be rewarded. 
> Normal: [EV] Soul Jumper Coins x50 and [EV] ‘You are the Jump King’ Package x1
> Hard: [EV] Soul Jumper Coins x50 and [EV] ‘You are the Jump King’ Package x2
> Maniac: [EV] Soul Jumper Coins x50 and [EV] ‘You are the Jump King’ Package x3
- Gathering Soul Jumper Coins to craft event items from NPC Gruton Coin Shop.

2. ‘Global Celebration Cake’ Event will be closed. 
- Being unable to use event items. 
- Event items will worth 1,000 Zenny when selling. 
3. ‘Global Goods Ticket’ Event will be closed.
- Being unable to use event items.

4. ‘New User Package’ Event will be closed.
